episodes.title: Complete Movie
episodes.synopsis: In a society devastated by the effects of an all-out war between heroes and villains, a mysterious giant fortress suddenly appears, engulfing towns and people one after another. Then, a man reminiscent of All Might, the 'symbol of peace', stands in front of Izuku and his friends...

info.title: Gasaraki
info.synopsis: Nell'immediato futuro, una forma di vita poco compresa nota come "Mile One" permette ad una ricca e potente famiglia giapponese, i Gowa, di produrre un'arma bipede che definiscono Tactical Armor (TA). Nello stesso periodo scoppia una guerra tra gli Stati Uniti e la fittizia nazione del Medio Oriente del Belgistan, simile alla guerra del golfo. Quando le forze militari degli Stati Uniti provano a conquistare la capitale, vengono sistematicamente spazzate via da quelle che sembrano TA nemiche. La famiglia Gowa coglie l'occasione per mettere alla prova la sua arma, e il pilota civile Yuushiro Gowa, insieme alla squadra a cui viene aggiunto, viene mandato in Belgistan. Qui incontra il pilota rivale Miharu, con cui sembra avere un profondo legame spirituale.

episodes.title: On the Ancient Stage of Stone
episodes.synopsis: Yushiro's movements, as part of a Gowa experiment, bring into existence a singularity sought by the Gowa Consortium. Suddenly, another dancer cries out from elsewhere pleading, ""Don't bring back the terror!"" Sensing the chilling voice, Yushiro falls out of his trance and the experiment fails.

episodes.title: Opening Movements
episodes.synopsis: As the Gowa Consortium evaluates the failure of their experiment with Yushiro, the United Nations responds to what seems to be a weapons test in the renegade post-Soviet Republic of Belgistan. After a successful air attack, the allied ground forces suffer a startling defeat, leading the Japanese company to reveal the secret of the Tactical Armor systems. It seems these units may have been responsible for the U.N. defeat at the hands of the Belgistanians.

episodes.title: Tantric Circle
episodes.synopsis: The Gowa Consortium clears the way for the deployment of the Tactical Armored System to Belgistan, enlisting Yushiro to come along. In the meantime, an American tank battalion faces staggering losses on their incursion into Belgistanian territory, confirming that Belgistan does possess bipedal weapons with formidable attack abilities.

episodes.title: Mirage
episodes.synopsis: The TA units arrived in Belgistan whereupon they are ordered to capture Shrine Hill, the location where the Belgistanians allegedly detonated their weapon of mass destruction. Surprising both the multinational forces and the TA unit, researchers from the Gowa Corporation arrive and confirm that Shrine Hill is virtually identical to Stage of Stone on which Yushiro performed his initial dance. This fact is confirmed when Yushiro enters a trance mode, leaves his TA and begins to perform the Gasara dance on Shrine Hill. Undeniably, a connection exists between Belgistan's release of power and the Gasara dance.

episodes.title: The Touching
episodes.synopsis: The Tactical Armored units of the Gowa Corporation clash with enemy TAs deep within Belgistanian territory and capture a defeated unit. Meanwhile the public is fascinated by the use of the new bipedal weapon systems, and SNN's very own Ronald Fagan attempts to get live footage for the viewing public.

episodes.title: The Puppet
episodes.synopsis: The evil organization Symbol institutes a coup in Belgistan to hide evidence of their involvement. The new leadership, lacking knowledge of Symbol's hand in events, immediately pleads for a ceasefire. Yushiro uses the opportunity to sneak deep into Belgistan and meet Miharu face-to-face, and the American government uses the pretext of weapons inspections to gather intelligence on the Gowa Corporation's bipedal weapons.

episodes.title: Return
episodes.synopsis: The squad of TA pilots defies orders to rescue Yushiro from Symbol forces in Belgistan. The Gowa Corporation fights to keep their technological secrets and captured enemy TA unit from the snooping Multinational forces and the hostile troops of another fictional post-Soviet Republic, the nation of Armekistan.

episodes.title: Harsh Worlds
episodes.synopsis: Amid evidence that the Japanese government is involved in some sort of cover-up regarding the TAs, Yushiro's elder brother Kazukiyo Gowa meets with Hiraku Nishida, an elderly, blind warrior who wishes to unleash selective violence against the Japanese people in order to strengthen Japan against growing opportunism and selfishness. At the Gowa laboratory the plot takes a startling twist when Miharu breaks into the Gowa headquarters to retrieve the missing components taken by the Japanese TAs in Belgistan. As she exits the plant, Miharu reveals to Yushiro the startling secret she has uncovered during the raid - the Gowa family refers to Yushiro as ""the test subject"" and that the real Yushiro Gowa has been deceased for years. As the episode ends, Yushiro's entire existence is mired in uncertainty.

episodes.title: Storehouse
episodes.synopsis: In an attempt to understand the information Miharu has imparted to him, Yushiro returns to his family home to confront his parents. At his ancestral home, Yushiro meets with his instructor, Sorachi, who leads Yushiro into an abandoned storehouse. There Yushiro discovers the cryogenically preserved body of Sorochi's son Ku-ya as well as a body that is probably his, along with the slouched form of a formidably-advanced robot, known as the Kugai. Meanwhile, Yushiro's sister, Misuzu, and Ataka, one of the female TA pilots, have followed Yushiro to the site, where they are surprised by the sudden appearance of Miharu and another of the symbol weapons platforms, known as Ishtars.

episodes.title: Kugai
episodes.synopsis: Sensing the proximity of Miharu and the other Symbol Ishtar (known colloquially as Fakes), Yushiro instinctively begins to perform the Gasara Dance. Before long, the stomach of the abandoned robot, known as the Kugai, opens up and takes in Yushiro as a pilot. The robot, adorned like an ancient Japanese samurai, battles and defeats the intruding weapons platforms and captures Miharu. When Yushiro leaves the Kugai, his master, Sorochi, informs him that Yushiro is a kai, a man with the special talent required to control the Kugai, and that the Kugai itself is a gift from Gasaraki. Sorochi says Yushiro must travel to Kyoto with Miharu in order to find out more.

episodes.title: Ties
episodes.synopsis: When Gowa's research on the artificial muscle recovered from Belgistan goes awry, the 3rd Experimentation Company is dispatched to try and resolve the situation. But the rogue pilot they must subdue isn't operating under normal circumstances.

episodes.title: Unravel
episodes.synopsis: Yushiro and Miharu are captured by the Gowa Corporation and SSDF. While Miharu is interrogated, Yushiro is charged in trying to succeed in subduing the rogue TA pilot.

episodes.title: Disembark
episodes.synopsis: The Gowa family undergoes a change in leadership, and with the new leader, a new direction with a goal of pitting all of Japan against Symbol. Meanwhile, Yushiro decides to follow the path of the kai in hopes that it will help him remember his past.

episodes.title: Companions
episodes.synopsis: Yushiro and Miharu follow the long-lost Path of the Kai to the threshold of Kyoto, home to the lost secrets of Yushiro and Miharu's past. Upon touching the threshold, the two young kais are given a glimpse of Japan in the Heian period, around 1,000 A.D.. The story tells of a disagreement in the Watanabe clan, the last protectors of the secret of Gasaraki. This disagreement leads to the accession of warlord Tsuna Watanabe who intends to use his clan's kai, Yushiro and Miharu, to reassert its power in the face of centralizing imperial power.

episodes.title: The Threshold
episodes.synopsis: The flashback to the Heian period continues. Tsuna Watanabe leads his clan and his Kugai into battle against the Imperial forces as the two young kais realize they are the tools of those around them. The evil regent Einyo manipulates Tsuna into unleashing the full power of the Kugai. The willpower of Yushiro and Miharu bring an end to the impending terror, which leads to the defeat Einyo and the death of Tsuna. The new leaders of the Watanabe clan agree to bury the secrets of the Kugai and retreat back into the mists of time. In the present, Yushiro and Miharu gain a greater understanding of their place in the continuing legacy of the kai.

episodes.title: Karma
episodes.synopsis: Yushiro and Miharu hide out in the Japanese slums, where they are helped by Wan, a gang member. Wan is actually a former member of Symbol and is recruited by Symbol to capture the two. Meanwhile, Kazukiyo, Hirokawa and Nishida plan their next move with the TAs, knowing that upcoming grain export news from the U.S. is sure to cause panic among the populace.

episodes.title: Chaos
episodes.synopsis: The Gowa family puts forth a plan to search for Yushiro. Meanwhile, Japan's Prime Minister is persuaded to deploy TAs to assist in controlling an impending riot.

episodes.title: Rear Window
episodes.synopsis: Nishida and Colonel Hayakawa meet to discuss the possible utilization of the 3rd Experimentation Company in Nishida's plans. Meanwhile, Symbol moves in to recapture Miharu.

episodes.title: Wails

episodes.title: Upheaval

episodes.title: Eternal
episodes.synopsis: The Americans, hoping to both provoke the Japanese and gather intel, send TAs to Ichigaya. But they only send one TA and it happens to be Miharu. Yushiro again confronts her, in hopes to dissuade her from harsh actions.

Himari and Mitsuki quickly become friends with the cheerful Julia. The two ask Julia to perform a live show. However, Julia says that she doesn't feel any excitement at the AiPri live show...

episodes.title: Juria`s Secret
episodes.synopsis: A new member joins the AiPri Club. Her name is Igarashi Julia. It's none other than Julia, the AiPri model. Apparently, she was excited after seeing Himari and Mitsuki's live performance and decided to join the club. However, Julia says she can't perform live until she can sing perfectly. Wanting to know Julia's true feelings, Himari and Mitsuki decide to ask her to teach them how to pasha. As a thank you, they perform live. Mitsuki realizes that Julia really wants to perform live. In fact, there was a song that Julia had always wanted to sing.

episodes.title: Elle`s Secret
episodes.synopsis: Mitsuki picks up a notepad in the library. It was dropped by Julia's roommate, Rokudou Eru. From the notepad, Mitsuki learns that Eru is a popular novelist who writes Aipri novels. Meanwhile, Juria, who has the complete opposite personality to the quiet Eru, lives in the same room but they are always fighting. Juria becomes depressed, thinking that Eru hates her. Hearing this, Mitsuki goes to see Eru. Eru has an Aipri bracelet. She confesses that she loves Aipri but doesn't have the confidence to perform live, so she became a novelist. Mitsuki invites her to join the Aipri club...

episodes.title: Showdown! Cleaning Match
episodes.synopsis: Paradise Academy's annual event, the School Cleaning Match, is being held. It's a cleaning contest between teams. Juria and Elle, who tend to fight, end up forming separate teams to compete against each other. Meanwhile, Himari and Mitsuki, who have each become leaders of different teams, are cleaning together with their palm-sized stuffed animals, "Puri Usa" and "Puri Neko". However, Tsumugi is jealous of Himari and Mitsuki who only show affection for the palm-sized stuffed animals, and runs off somewhere with the chicks that Mr. Matsuoka keeps. Will Himari and Mitsuki be able to find Tsumugi? And what will be the outcome of the cleaning match?

episodes.title: The Secret AiPri Contest
episodes.synopsis: Princess Ring's butler, Shitsumu, makes an important announcement. The first Eye Puri Contest will be held! It's a contest to decide the world's best eye puri that will make Princess Ring's heart flutter, sparkle and be thrilled. The winner will be given an eternal outfit. To qualify, the "Ring Gauge" must be filled up. However, Himari and Mitsuki don't have much saved up... This time, the key is to succeed in the "Jewel Buzzrium Change" that Juria and El showed them. Mitsuki and Himari immediately go to ask Juria and El how to change into a Jewel Buzzrium, but...

episodes.title: The Two After the Rain
episodes.synopsis: Ever since seeing Himari and Mitsuki's live performance, Juria has become interested in duos. Eru has also been writing a novel with a duo theme. Encouraged by Mitsuki's words, Eru tries to invite Juria to join a duo. However, Juria has already received an invitation from another Aipri member. Eru is shocked to see Juria looking so happy. Juria encourages Eru, who is feeling down, and calls her out on a rainy day. However, the two get into a huge fight when Eru says she "doesn't like" a song that Juria loves at all...

episodes.title: The AiPri Contest Begins!
episodes.synopsis: Himari and Mitsuki are still depressed after failing to perform the Jewel Buzzlume Change. Mitsuki invites Himari to start training. However, worried that Mitsuki is pushing herself too hard, Chii gives Himari some advice. Himari tries to cheer Mitsuki up by organizing a "Mitsuki Love Party" filled with all of Mitsuki's favorite things. Can Mitsuki recover? Meanwhile, the first Aipri Contest begins. Their opponents are the duo "Love Juriel", consisting of Julia and Elle. Who will be the winner?

episodes.title: Princess Ring Appears
episodes.synopsis: Himari and Mitsuki, winners of the first AiPri contest, will perform a debut live show in front of Princess Ring. Unable to hide their nervousness, the two join up with Julia and Elle and finally head to the palace where Princess Ring is. However, only those who are recognized by the princess at this live show will be able to meet Princess Ring. The Love Juliet duo perform a live show with excitement at full throttle. Poppin' Dreamin' also performs a dignified live show worthy of the name Star AiPri. After the two groups put on a fantastic live show, Princess Ring Clover finally appears before them...

episodes.title: The Rumored Transfer Student
episodes.synopsis: A certain Aipri is very popular in Aipriverse right now. Apparently he is produced by a very talented producer, but he hasn't had any live shows recently. Meanwhile, Nanaura Subaru transfers to Paradise Academy, class 1A. However, because of his blunt and silent attitude, everyone around him is scared of him. Hiiro, who was walking in a hurry down the hallway, bumps into Subaru. Hiiro is scared, but when Subaru picks up something he's lost, he is surprised. However, Hinata sees what is happening. Hinata thinks that Subaru is scaring her sister, so she challenges him to a soccer match, but...

episodes.title: A Single Secret
episodes.synopsis: A famous singing teacher from overseas said that he wanted to produce Mitsuki. Mitsuki wants to take on the challenge, but is worried about leaving Himari behind. Himari is also sad to see Mitsuki go, but wants to support her friend's dream. Since then, Himari has started to work hard to be able to do everything on her own so that Mitsuki won't worry. After listening to Subaru and Wako's talk, Mitsuki has started to become conscious of her "new self." Will Mitsuki and Himari be separated like this?

episodes.title: Otome the Producer
episodes.synopsis: Subaru has started singing again as an AiPri member. He is practicing alone, but the repertoire is not one that producer OtoP thought up, but something he came up with herself. Meanwhile, a transfer student, Nanaura Otome, comes to Himari and Mitsuki's class. She produces Paradise Academy to make school life more enjoyable. She also knows a lot about AiPri. Her true identity is Subaru's producer, OtoP. Himari and Mitsuki are surprised. However, when Subaru finds Otome, he suddenly runs away for some reason...

episodes.title: Fly! Jumping Rocket
episodes.synopsis: The second Ai-Pri Contest is announced. Himari, who has not yet been able to change into Space Buzzrium, is full of enthusiasm. Meanwhile, Otome tells Subaru that she does not need to enter the contest. Subaru tells her clearly that he wants to graduate from Otome's production. However, Otome insists that "absolutely not" and runs away without listening to what he has to say. Mitsuki, who gives Subaru advice, finds out that Otome and Subaru are from Ai-Pri School. Apparently, Otome was taking singing lessons at the time, but she had a "secret."

episodes.title: My Melody and Kuromi Are Here
episodes.synopsis: Himari, Mitsuki, and Tsumugi meet My Melody at the AiPriverse. The three become friends and make a guest appearance on the "AiPri♪My Melody Channel" broadcast. The event is to give advice to the My Melody friends on their troubles. Then, Kuromi appears! Kuromi answers the My Melody friends' troubles by saying, "Just be like me!" But how can we become like Kuromi? When asked, Kuromi tries to teach Himari and the other AiPri how to "be like Kuromi"...

episodes.title: A Friend`s Smile
episodes.synopsis: When Jumpin' Rocket decides to enter the second Aipri Contest, Shitsumu announces that they will be eligible to enter by the end of the day. Unlike Mitsuki, Himari is not yet able to change into a Space Buzzrium and feels anxious. At that time, Umi, a first-year elementary school student and classmate Nagisa's younger sister, comes to class 2A. Umi says she is a big fan of Aipri Himari. However, she gets into a fight with Nagisa and runs out of the classroom. When Himari finds out that tomorrow is Umi's "day to work hard at the hospital," she chases after her as the deadline for the contest approaches...

episodes.title: An Aimu Gathering!
episodes.synopsis: The final exams are over at Paradise Academy, and summer vacation is just around the corner. Mitsuki is writing a letter to someone. Himari wants to perform a live show, but Aipriverse is currently under maintenance. At Aipriverse, Aimu and the others are making a big fuss, saying that a ghost has appeared. As everyone tries to find out the true identity of the ghost, Aimu and the others end up becoming engrossed in Aipri's live show. However, in the midst of all this, the true identity of the ghost is finally revealed...

episodes.title: The Second AiPri Contest
episodes.synopsis: Finally, the 2nd Aipri Contest was held. Even before the live show, Otome is distributing Jumpin Rocket with Subaru to enliven the Pritomo and others. And finally, the contest begins. Both Mitsuki and Jumpin Rocket showed great performances. The one who wins is the one who enlivens more Pritomo. Which hand will win the championship...!?

episodes.title: Mitsuki and the Start of Summer
episodes.synopsis: The debut live performance of Eternal Space Coord is held. Subaru and Otome of Jumpin' Rocket show off a dazzling performance. The theme of the 3rd Aipri Contest is announced as "Animal Buzzlume Change". After "excitement" and "longing", what emotion will be the key next? Researching Buzzlume Change, training Aipri, a summer vacation... Chii proposes a summer training camp for the Aipri club to do it all.

episodes.title: Would You Like Delichiious Shaved Ice?
episodes.synopsis: During the summer vacation, the "Aipri training camp" of the Aipri club has started. Chii runs a shaved ice shop in the sea with Vivi. Vivi is a first-year junior high school student who yearns for Ipri. Himari and the others are all playing on the beach. Then Sakura, Tamaki, Airi, and Rinrin appeared from the sea! He temporarily returned home from studying abroad to be a special coach for the training camp. On the other hand, Vivi helped the shaved ice shop and said, "I don't like myself, so I want to be Chii-chan." In the meantime, Chii, who worked too hard on the work of the student council and the work of the shaved ice shop, collapsed...

episodes.title: Tsumugi and the Summer Fest
episodes.synopsis: During the summer vacation "AiPri Training Camp," Sakura and the others are conducting rigorous training. Tsumugi watches Himari and the others as they work hard. During the Aipri Birthday, energy is returning to Tsumugi's Aipri Brace. Upon learning this, Himari invites them to do a live performance right away, but Tsumugi says she wants to do a special live performance. In order to revive Secret Friends ∞, a summer festival "Aipri the Summer" is being held, produced by Oto-P!

episodes.title: Vivi Is Chii`s Brightest Disciple
episodes.synopsis: Vivi, who has become Chii's number one pupil, joins the AiPri club. Although she doesn't have an AiPri bracelet yet, Vivi desperately tries to keep up with the intensive training at the AiPri training camp. However, she pushes herself until she is completely exhausted and is scolded by Chii. Just as Vivi is feeling down, her advisor, Sarashina-sensei, appears and gives her an AiPri bracelet. Overjoyed, Vivi joins the AiPri-birth. Her registration as an AiPri is complete, and it's finally time for the live performance. However, when it's her turn to perform, Vivi doesn't appear on stage...

episodes.title: All-Out Match! Vivi vs Chii
episodes.synopsis: Vivi, who made a shocking debut, is being talked about among the PriTomos members as a possible winner of the 3rd Aipri Grand Prix. However, Chii is cold towards Vivi. In fact, she has been feeling anxious about Vivi, who achieved the Buzzlume Change at her debut live show. Sakura tells Chii, "There's something you're missing right now." Meanwhile, Vivi, wanting to be recognized by Chii, challenges Chii to a showdown. What will be the outcome of this showdown between master and disciple?

episodes.title: The Shiny Brightest Star
episodes.synopsis: It's finally the final day of the AiPri training camp. With the 3rd AiPri Contest fast approaching, Juria is struggling with her summer homework. Himari and the others are trying out a live performance to qualify for the 3rd AiPri Contest. Himari, Mitsuki, and Tsumugi from Secret Friends ∞ successfully complete the Animal Buzzlume Change and secure their place in the contest. Chii tries with ease, but unfortunately fails to change into Buzzlume. Chii has lost sight of who she is...

episodes.title: Mitsuki`s Secret Birthday
episodes.synopsis: The second semester has begun. Mitsuki's birthday is coming up soon. Himari is secretly planning a surprise birthday party for Mitsuki. Himari has heard from Yakumo that Mitsuki has treasured a ring since she was little. Together with the members of the Ai-Pri Club, she begins to prepare for the birthday party. Will the surprise birthday party be a success?

episodes.title: A Tearful AiPri Contest
episodes.synopsis: The third AiPri Contest has finally begun. Two groups are competing: Secret Friends ∞ and Vivi & Chii. Secret Friends ∞ have achieved the Animal Bazurium Change. However, Himari and Mitsuki can barely keep up with Tsumugi, who is showing off an incredible performance unlike anything they've ever seen before. And Vivi & Chii, whose Pritomo members put on a rousing live performance, is the one to take home the crown of victory...?!

episodes.title: Her First Stage
episodes.synopsis: With Himari and the rest of the AiPri Princess Club in the spotlight, Vivi and Chii takes on the challenge of their debut live show. After achieving the Animal Buzzrium Change, the two give a performance that is full of "true self" and confidence. However, the debut live show doesn't end there. Ring Princess, moved by their performance, says she will "give you a reward"...!?

episodes.title: The Princess` Miracle
episodes.synopsis: The school principal and Nonose-san visit the Aipri Club. They tell them about an Aipri contest that was held only once in the past. In that contest, one Aipri won by successfully performing five Buzzrium Changes, which was called the "Princess's Miracle." However, it is unknown who the winning Aipri was. Himari and the others look at the records of their previous live performances to try to get to the bottom of the mystery.

episodes.title: The Secret Test
episodes.synopsis: Having missed out on the win in the last AiPri Contest and feeling frustrated, Tsumugi is currently training hard for the next contest. "I want to be a flower that sparkles more, that gives courage," she says, and so she goes alone to meet Princess Ring. Tsumugi asks what she should do to give a live performance that is as sparkling and cute as Princess Ring. Princess Ring decides to conduct a secret test to see if Tsumugi's feelings are genuine. Dressed in her school uniform, Tsumugi arrives at Paradise Academy, an Ai-Priverse school created by Princess Ring. What exactly is the content of the test...?

episodes.title: True Feelings
episodes.synopsis: Chii is investigating the secret of Princess Ring. She hasn't figured anything out yet, but Mitsuki says she remembers something. When she was little, the first Aipri Princess Mitsuki dreamed of was Princess Ring. Thinking this, Mitsuki searches for a memorable picture drawn by Himari. However, when she finds it, she tears it up. Meanwhile, Princess Ring gives the Aipri Princesses a "secret test." Mitsuki is unable to concentrate, worried about the picture she tore. While Himari and the others are taking their respective tests, Mitsuki meets her younger self...

episodes.title: Fortune-Telling and the Secret Dream
episodes.synopsis: Himari is obsessed with fortune telling. Then her classmate, Ichika Kisaragi, calls out to her. Ichika is also a big fan of fortune telling. She says she has something she wants to ask Mitsuki. Apparently, her fortune told her that Yakumo is her "soulmate." After hearing Yakumo's dream of attending Dream Star Academy after graduation, Ichika declares that she will also go to the same school. However, her childhood friend, Nagisa, is worried about Ichika, who is not good at studying. Nagisa has always wanted to be with her, so she consults Mitsuki and Himari, but...

episodes.title: Princess Ring and the Secret Halloween
episodes.synopsis: Juria and Elle become Halloween executive committee members and plan a fun party. Tsumugi invites Princess Ring to the Halloween party being held at Paradise Academy. When she thinks it sounds fun, Princess Ring turns into a Pricon stuffed animal and heads to Paradise Academy. Princess Ring goes around the Halloween party as Pricon, exchanging sweets and dressing up as ghosts. Meanwhile, she sees Juria and El, who are also on the executive committee, fighting...

episodes.title: Tsumugi and Ring
episodes.synopsis: Tsumugi visits Princess Ring. Princess Ring says there is still a lot she doesn't know. Tsumugi tells her she will teach her many things and they make a promise to meet the next day at lunchtime. In order to learn more, Tsumugi goes to the Paradise Academy library disguised as Mugi-chan. Tsumugi is excited to teach Princess Ring even more. However, she becomes so engrossed in the book that she forgets her promise to Princess Ring...

episodes.title: The Lonely Princess
episodes.synopsis: Princess Ring is worried because she has not been able to make up with Tsumugi. Tsumugi, who is also worried, visits Chii. After hearing about how to make up, Tsumugi heads out. Meanwhile, Princess Ring has not filled up her ring gauge and cannot participate in the 4th AiPri Contest. The reason for this is that Princess Ring has no one to whom she wants to convey her feelings, in other words, no friends. Tsumugi comes to Princess Ring with many presents. However, Princess Ring sends Tsumugi home without accepting any. Princess Ring is alone in the secret garden when Mitsuki comes to her...

episodes.title: A Blooming AiPri Contest
episodes.synopsis: The 4th AiPri Contest is about to begin. The participants are the duo Poppin' Dreamin' who consist of Himari Aozora and Mitsuki Hoshikawa, and Luminous Flora who consist of Tsumugi Suzukaze and Ring Clover. Tsumugi declares, "We're friends, but this time we're rivals."

episodes.title: Our Courage
episodes.synopsis: It's time for the 4th Aipri Contest debut live performance. The first live performance was by Luminous Flora. After witnessing their amazing performance, Mitsuki and Himari make a decision. The two of them decide to withdraw from the debut live performance. What are Mitsuki and Himari thinking...?

episodes.title: Quartet Star Has Returned
episodes.synopsis: Sakura, Tamaki, Airi, and Rinrin have returned to Paradise Academy! However, something seems strange. Everyone exudes a sharp, stern aura. Tsumugi says that she senses the scent of a "Dark Quartet Star" among the four Quartet Stars. Mitsuki tries to find out the truth about what happened to Sakura and the others. Have Sakura and the other four really become Dark Quartet Stars...?

episodes.title: Himari`s Mom`s Secret
episodes.synopsis: It's the day of the three-way meeting to discuss their future paths. While Mitsuki's dream is to study abroad and study singing, Himari's dreams are still vague. Then, Himari's mother reveals her feelings to her.

episodes.title: The Secret of the Ring
episodes.synopsis: On the day of their parent-teacher conference, Sakura told Mitsuki, "If you have the desire to spread your wings, it's better to do it as soon as possible." Mitsuki is wondering if it would be better to speed up her study abroad. Christmas is just around the corner. Everyone at Paradise Academy seems to be having fun preparing for Christmas. Meanwhile, Mitsuki is remembering something. She once met an AiPri around Christmas time. Mitsuki exchanged star-shaped candy and a winged ring with that AiPri. That AiPri's name was Ring Clover. But even now, she knows her true identity well...

episodes.title: A Fun Winter Festival!
episodes.synopsis: Today we have a special project, bringing you a "Christmas Winter Festival" with everyone from Aipri! Following live performances by Jumpin' Rocket, Quartet Star, and Vivi & Chii, Julia, Elle, Subaru, and Mitsuki also performed solo live shows. As the excitement reached its climax, Princess Ring also appeared. It seemed she was envious of the fun-looking event. With Princess Ring joining in, the Winter Festival moved into the second half. The excitement of the Pritomo members is rising even more!

episodes.title: Lots of Mitsuki-chan
episodes.synopsis: Mitsuki is asked by a famous song producer to send a promotional video. Upon hearing this, Himari declares that she will be the director and make the promotional video. With the help of Tsumugi, Hinata, Yakumo, and Hiiro, they begin filming. Under the cold sky, they somehow manage to finish filming. They were supposed to gather everyone together for a unveiling party, but Himari made a mistake in the controls and the filmed footage was lost. They try to re-shoot it, but Mitsuki ends up with a fever... What will Himari do?

episodes.title: Legend Story!!!!
episodes.synopsis: The 5th Aipri Contest is coming up soon. Sakura and the others are excited to enter and uncover the secrets of the Aipriverse. Airi has decided that she needs a new song to put her all on the line for the contest. Airi boasts that she will have the new song completed by the next live performance. She interviews the Aipri and the others and expands on the image of the new song. Later, while talking with Mitsuki, Airi reaffirms her dream of "not just performing a live performance, but creating the live performance itself." However, she is troubled by the pressure of not being able to write a new song yet. Will Quartet Star be able to complete their new song?

episodes.title: A Heartfelt AiPri Contest
episodes.synopsis: The 5th Aipri Contest is coming up soon. Mitsuki has decided to tell Himari that after the contest she will be studying abroad in the spring, and that she only has three more months to be with her. And finally, the day of the contest arrives. Poppin' Dreamin' and Quartet Star will be on stage. Mitsuki tells Himari that there is something she wants to talk to her about after the contest is over. Himari also asks Mitsuki for a date on Valentine's Day. Even though she senses that Mitsuki will soon be gone, Himari takes on the challenge of the contest.

episodes.title: Because I Love You
episodes.synopsis: Three days have passed since the 5th Aipri Contest. Himari has vacated her room with Mitsuki and is staying in Juria and Ellu's room. It's lonely and painful to see Mitsuki. Mitsuki becomes worried when Himari disappears from her room. Meanwhile, after receiving "certain words" from teacher Wako, Mitsuki decides to tell Himari that "we'll be saying goodbye in three months." However, Himari doesn't want to hear them and starts running away from Mitsuki...

episodes.title: The Secret Valentine`s Day
episodes.synopsis: Valentine's Day is approaching, and six groups -Poppin Dreamin, Quartet Star, Vivi & Chii, Jumping Rocket, Love JurieL and Luminous Flora - are announced to be competing in the Final AiPri Contest. Himari and Mitsuki are preparing for their promised date. At that time, the two receive an invitation to a Valentine's Day party from Princess Ring. Princess Ring thanks the six groups of AiPri, saying, "I feel so happy that all the Buzzrium Changes are here." Subaru tells Princess Ring that he has prepared a special live performance for Valentine's Day. Wako-sensei is looking forward to the performance, but...

episodes.title: Wako and Ring
episodes.synopsis: At the same time that Wako-Sensei collapsed, Princess Ring fell into a deep sleep. At Paradise Academy, Chairman Kindaichi began to speak about Princess Ring. In the past, Princess Ring had attempted five different Buzzlume Changes. Then, on the night of her 15th birthday, she successfully completed the Jewel, Space, Animal, Flower, and Melody Buzzlume Changes, miraculously achieving the "Princess's Miracle." However, at the same time, Princess Ring lost all of her memories. The true identity of Princess Ring was none other than Ms. Wako Sarashina. And in the "Secret Garden," Ms. Wako reunited with Princess Ring, who was herself...

episodes.title: Ring Clover`s Secret
episodes.synopsis: The two rings, Ring Tiara and Star Wing, become one and show a light. At the end of the light is a book. To rescue Princess Ring, Mitsuki and Himari jump into the light that envelops the book. They arrive at the forest where Mitsuki visited as a child. There, a book bearing the Jewel crest appears. Julia and Elle realize that they need to perform a Jewel Buzzlume Change to open the book, and so they begin their live performance.

episodes.title: Connecting Ring
episodes.synopsis: Tsumugi performs a live concert to bring back Princess Ring. She sings with all her might to convey her "courage" and "love," and performs a Flower Buzzlume Change. Meanwhile, Mitsuki and Himari are in the secret garden, looking at Princess Ring's memories. When Mitsuki was little, she wanted to be friends with Princess Ring, so she gave her her treasured star-shaped sugar candy. After that, the former Princess Ring successfully performed five Buzzlume Changes. Following Tsumugi, Quartet Star performs a live concert to achieve a Melody Buzzlume Change. They are a great success, and the five crests light up. But Princess Ring does not appear...

episodes.title: Open the Door
episodes.synopsis: It's been a week since Princess Ring returned to Aipriverse. Life has returned to normal for Mitsuki and the others at Paradise Academy. Mr. Sarashina tells Mitsuki and the others about what happened to Teacher Wako. Mr. Sarashina is trying to restore Princess Ring's memories to Teacher Wako. However, Princess Ring and Teacher Wako end up going their separate ways. After the maintenance on Aipriverse is finished, Mitsuki and the others go to Princess Ring. Princess Ring has prepared the rest of the Valentine's Day feast.

episodes.title: The Final AiPri Contest Begins
episodes.synopsis: The Final AiPri Contest has begun! The six participating groups are Poppin' Dreamin', Love Juliet, Jumpin' Rocket, Vivi & Chii, Luminous Flora, and Quartet Star. The winner will be awarded the title of "Eternal AiPri", an eye puri that will be passed down forever, and a special outfit, the "Eternal AiPri Outfit", that only the person who reaches the top is allowed to wear. The final contest has finally begun!

episodes.title: We`re AiPri
episodes.synopsis: The Final AiPri Contest reaches its climax. Next up to perform is Luminous Flora. Ring and Tsumugi are encouraged by the cheers of the Pritmo girls. And finally, Mitsuki and Himari perform Poppin' Dreamin'. Mitsuki and Himari sing, believing that even though they are walking separate paths, their futures are intertwined. And so, all six groups have finished their live performances. The winning team is finally announced. Who will take home the title of Eternal AiPri...?!

episodes.title: The Song of Departure
episodes.synopsis: The Final AiPri Contest has ended, and Paradise Academy is holding its graduation ceremony for Sakura and the others. However, Sakura declares that she doesn't want to graduate and locks herself in her room. Thanks to Mitsuki's efforts, Sakura is eventually able to come out of her room and gives a splendid speech as the representative of the graduating class. Chi, the representative of the current students, has a surprise in store for Sakura, Tamaki, Airi, Rinrin, and the other third-year students who are graduating. It is a live performance by Mitsuki and Himari, who have become Princess AiPri. The two sing with heartfelt gratitude.

episodes.title: Himitsu no AiPri
episodes.synopsis: At the AiPri birthday celebration, Mitsuki announces that she will be taking a break from AiPri for a while. Before that, she performs a live show with Himari. After their final performance, Himari declares to Mitsuki her dream: to become "a sparkling, glittering, star-like Eternal AiPri, even more amazing than Eternal AiPri." They intended to say goodbye with smiles, but tears well up in both Himari and Mitsuki's eyes. They promise to fulfill each other's dreams, and Mitsuki sets off with a smile. Then the seasons change, and it's summer—and Himari, separated from Mitsuki, is left...

episodes.title: Return of the Maid
episodes.synopsis: Slash still seems to hate Ryuuga. He follows him all day, while Ryuuga gets his school teacher job back. Just as Ryuuga is about to teleport back up to his station, Slash confronts him, and they begin fighting. Mahoro busts in and stops them. She lectures them a bit, and then runs off chasing Suguru. The next day, Mahoro is going shopping, and Suguru is supposed to help her, but they end up meeting this small girl, who is being chased by mecha robots out to kill her. She is an android, and they seem to want her dead. So Mahoro protects her.

episodes.title: From Today On, You Are Minawa
episodes.synopsis: Since Minawa (#370) is staying with Suguru and Mahoro, they use the pretense that she is Mahoro's younger sister, and that her name is Minawa. She has to attend school with Suguru, since she is supposed to be 14. However at school, she keeps messing up, and getting injured. Meanwhile, at school, Ryuuga and Slash know that she is from the Caretakers organization, so they too keep an eye on her for suspicious activity, since the Caretakers organization is not to be trusted.

episodes.title: Dreams Should Be Grand
episodes.synopsis: Mahoro wants to have a bigger bust, since she was designed as a combat android, her parts were built for maximum efficiency. So, she buys strange machines to try different things. However, they prove to be unsuccessful. The next day, she gets a mysterious package from Vesper, containing a counter-attack device. They are hidden missles in a bra to counter attack a super machine sent by the Caretakers. She uses them, and saves the day.

episodes.title: Looking For A Lost Object
episodes.synopsis: Mahoro receives word from Vesper headquarters that theres a dangerous item hidden under the school somewhere on the premises. Later reports confirm that it might be a bomb. So, Vesper has Mahoro go and find the item. The Caretakers organization gets word of this, and when the item is found, they try to take it. Meanwhile, the students believe its a magic love-granting item, so they too try to take it. However, it ends up being Shikijou-sensei's time capsule from her student days, and she was trying to find it before the construction workers did.

episodes.title: Will I Catch a Cold Tomorrow?
episodes.synopsis: Its Christmas time, and everyone is planning to have a party at Suguru's house. So, Mahoro and Minawa are doing the decorations. Lately, after school, Suguru has been going up to his room, he is making christmas gifts for everyone in his house. So, they have the party, and everything is fun. They end up trading gifts in Secret Santa Style, and there was mostly junk, but everyone still had a fun time.

episodes.title: Doing Delightful New Year Things
episodes.synopsis: Christmas has passed, and now its New Years. So the group goes to the traditional shrine on the first day to get good luck. Of course, there's still the rivalry between Mahoro and Shikijou-sensei, and that persists for the entire course of the winter break. Every day, the group does something different, and each day they have some fun. At the end of the break, everyone realizes what they need to do for the upcoming year, and having had their fun, they have no choice but to get serious again.

episodes.title: Don`t Ever Come Back Again!
episodes.synopsis: There is a famous festival in the city of Hiryu, which stems back from the feudal days. It is a fighting festival, however, due to the rules established in recent years, its rather safe. Anyhow, Suguru wants to participate, and Mahoro is against it. However, he sneaks out, and Mahoro and Minawa go out to find him. However, they get caught up in the festival themsevles, that they forget their goal. In the end, Mahoro ends up winning the festival fighting contest!

episodes.title: Grandfather and Grandson
episodes.synopsis: Suguru's grandfather decides to come and visit. He actually lives in another city, and is very busy, since he is the Governor. However, he gets worried about Suguru, and comes to visit. While he is there, everyone shows up, and they all have a blast together. Grandfather then realizes that he should not worry, as there are people around to take care of Suguru. He gives Suguru some manly advice, and also has a good talk with Mahoro, after which he leaves. Meanwhile, the Caretakers are planning something...

episodes.title: Sweeter Than Love, but a Bit Bitter
episodes.synopsis: Since its Valentines day, all the girls are going crazy making and giving chocolates. Mahoro makes some, and meanwhile teaches Minawa how to make some. She then tells Minawa to give it to someone she likes, so she tries Mahoro, then Suguru, but Mahoro stops that. In the afternoon, the girls all stop by and give Suguru some chocolate. However, Minawa takes Mahoro's suggestion to give the chocolate to Hamaji, and she does.

episodes.title: Things I Like
episodes.synopsis: The evil scientist's android comes and tells Minawa what to do, as per their promise. She holds Suguru hostage, and they are taken to their lab. Mahoro finds out from Slash, who gets badly injured in the process. Mahoro pursues them, and Minawa finally realizes the fun she had with everyone. She helps to free Mahoro from the electric holders, but she gets shot in the process. Due to the shocking, Mahoro falls unconscious, and Suguru as escaping, jumps back after her into the the oncoming fire.

episodes.title: A Wish, the Color of Cherry Blossoms
episodes.synopsis: Slash's self-repair kicks in, and he goes to get Ryuuga, both of which rescue Suguru, Mahoro, and Minawa. They are then taken to the VESPER base, and Suguru is told the whole story. Meanwhile, Mahoro and Minawa are recovering. They do some tests on Minawa, and her internal systems are kind of messed up, and Ryuuga offers SAINT's technology to fix her. So, she meets up with everyone for a quick trip, and then gets ready to go. Meanwhile, Mahoro has become more and more attached to Suguru, their friends, and her life, and cannot bear the pain to leave anymore.

episodes.title: The Annunciation
episodes.synopsis: Events are beginning to happen that will shape the future of the world. The American President was planning to reveal the whole affair to the general public. The Keepers (Caretakers) organization finds about this, and has him assassinated beforehand. Meanwhile, Mahoro fights for her life. For the first time in her life, she is scared of her future, and of death.

episodes.title: End of a Dream
episodes.synopsis: Yuuichiro is planning to attend a party held by the Keepers. He was once friends with the leader, but believed that Vesper was the key to the future. However, he goes to the party with the intention of killing them. He prepares a battle plan with Slash. He brings his locket, and as the discussion heats up, Slash is summoned in full battle mode. Slash tears up everyone and everything in the place. However, due to the excess forces of the Keepers, Yuuichiro pays the ultimate price, but the Keepers seem to have been stopped. Meanwhile, Mahoro and Suguru escape to Bolivia. However, they are followed by Feldrance. Suguru is told to run to the nearest city, and Mahoro and Feldrance fight. As Feldrance's strength is continually increasing, Mahoro's is decreasing. So, she is forced to use her ultimate weapon, resulting in a double-KO.

episodes.title: Na-Geanna
episodes.synopsis: After Mahoro's final departure, the years go by for Suguru. He joins VESPER and becomes an assassin with attributes greater than any android they have ever had. He has one purpose, to hunt down and kill all Androids, especially those affiliated with the Keepers. Although that group is history, there are still some loyal to it, and Suguru disposes of them. One day, after getting quite drunk, he ends up meeting a girl who looks like Mahoro, and it turns out to really be Mahoro, as SAINT's technology, and Matthew's will has recreated her, even though it took 20 years to do so. She finally finds him, and convinces him to finally go back to Tokyo.

info.title: Isekai Office Worker: The Other World's Books Depend on the Bean Counter
info.synopsis: Seiichirō Kondō è un contabile di 29 anni, un vero stacanovista. Quando viene accidentalmente trasportato in un altro mondo non solo pretende subito un lavoro, ma inizia a mettere in riga l'apatico Ufficio contabilità reale! Quando si ritrova nei guai e rischia di morire per eccesso di lavoro, l'affascinante quanto gelido generale Aresh interviene per salvarlo. Fra i due nasce un rapporto fisico unico che sembra quasi una cura... ma riuscirà Seiichirō a far sciogliere il cuore del famigerato Nobile di ghiaccio, oppure sarà destinato a sposare il suo lavoro per sempre?

info.title: Blue Comet SPT Layzner
info.synopsis: Corre l'anno 1996 e l'umanità è talmente progredita da viaggiare sulla Luna e su Marte e stabilirvi insediamenti. Tuttavia, la Guerra Fredda è ancora in corso, con tensioni sempre crescenti tra gli Stati Uniti d'America e l'Unione Sovietica, e la minaccia di una guerra nucleare incombe sempre all'orizzonte. Presto una minaccia sconosciuta si abbatte però sull'umanità: su Marte, i membri di un programma di scambio culturale finanziato dalle Nazioni Unite per promuovere la pace e il dialogo tra le nazioni si ritrovano intrappolati in un fuoco incrociato tra tre misteriosi robot umanoidi che uccidono quasi tutti gli studenti. Solo pochissimi sopravvivono, ma si ritrovano isolati su un pianeta ormai inospitale dopo la battaglia. E, come se non bastasse, il pilota di un quarto robot, che da tempo cerca di non coinvolgere i civili nella battaglia, si presenta ai sopravvissuti come Albatro Null Eiji Asuka, dicendo loro che la Terra è stata presa di mira dal lontano impero di Grados...

info.title: Sword Art Online: Unanswered//butterfly
info.synopsis: Protagonisti della storia sono Emirun e Rex, due ragazzi che si conoscevano nel mondo reale e che si ritrovano per caso all'interno del gioco. Per riuscire a sopravvivere in questo mondo spietato, si uniscono a un gruppo di esplorazione che cerca di raccogliere informazioni e affrontare i pericoli dei piani del castello. Un giorno, però, la loro squadra viene attaccata da un misterioso Player Killer conosciuto come il Black Swordsman. Quando Emirun arriva sul posto, trova Rex distrutto dalla disperazione e il misterioso spadaccino davanti a lui: l'intero gruppo è stato sterminato. Decisi a vendicare i compagni caduti e diventare più forti, Emirun e Rex cercano l'aiuto della leggendaria spadaccina Asuna e iniziano un duro allenamento sotto la sua guida. In un gioco mortale dove anche i giocatori possono diventare nemici, i due dovranno affrontare dolore, paura e tradimento per trovare un nuovo inizio.
